bottleneck: NGRAM self-speculation is BUG_CONFIRMED at greedy t=0 (F1/G2-E1) and therefore non-promotable, so the largest exact-runtime lever on this branch (G2-measured ~1.22x aggregate, decode-heavy points 1.5-1.97x) is blocked on correctness, not speed. This iteration is a fault-line narrowing, not a throughput claim. Structure: the commit rule (eagle.cuh VerifyTreeGreedy) makes every committed token an argmax of a verify logits row, so NGRAM is greedy-exact iff each accepted chain node's attention row sees exactly `prefix + committed chain to that node`. That invariant splits the fault space: a bad draft tree (corpus match state, recency, duplicated check suffix) can only change accept rates, never move a committed token off the OFF argmax; the defect must be a verify-input mask/position inconsistency, a KV slot/prefix-length misalignment in the verify window, or the post-commit KV/bonus move. G2-E1's 1.0-3.9 nat gaps, first-diff positions only {4,6}, pass-nondeterminism 6/24 vs OFF 0/24, and the one self-top-1 mismatch all fit a row-subset context corruption of that kind.

patch: Single source delta on 47030d8: add _sanitize_tree_mask(mask, bs, draft_token_num) in python/sglang/srt/speculative/ngram_worker.py and apply it to the numpy corpus mask immediately after _prepare_draft_tokens(), before both consumers (the device reconstruct kernel's tree_mask copy and the full attention-mask build). np.tril(k=0) keeps the diagonal and all strict ancestors; any upper-triangular bit is dropped and counted in a WARNING. It is allocation-free and bit-identical for a causal mask (early-out on np.triu(...).any()), so it is exact-by-construction on every mask this corpus can produce: it only removes bits that the position/retrieve derivation already ignores. It is explicitly NOT a root-cause fix and NOT a throughput candidate; it is an invariant guard whose WARNING is the probe's grep signal. No CLI flag, scheduler, measurement, corpus, seed, reference or evaluator code is touched.

learning: The key methodological result is the exactness invariant rather than any single suspect: because every committed token is an argmax of a verify logits row under the mask-defined context, the entire corpus/matching side (recency state, BFS breadth, duplicated check suffix, cross-request trie pollution) is provably incapable of moving a committed token off the OFF argmax - it can only change accept length. That eliminates trial-2 proposal #1 (draft-width tuning) as a correctness lever and redirects all remaining work to the verify input and post-commit move. Four concrete hypotheses are refuted with source evidence, including the previous session's own H1: the mask is causal on every corpus path (uint8 byte-wise parent-prefix memcpy with prevs[i] < i, plus causal truncate), the root is the pending bonus not a duplicated KV token, seq_lens_cpu and seq_lens share one published buffer (overlap_utils.py:587-647), and accept/KV-move bookkeeping is self-consistent for the identity retrieve_index. Remaining uncertainty is concentrated in GPU-visible behaviour: the assign_extend_cache_locs draft-slot window vs the widened CSR read, and the shared post-commit KV move; neither is decidable statically from this sandbox. No numeric evidence was produced in this iteration and none is claimed.
